title: Cognition-Oriented Emotion Tracing from Causes to Consequences in Real-World Social Scenes
abstract: arXiv:2610.11410v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Affective computing has progressed from categorical emotion recognition to open-ended affective analysis with large multimodal models. Yet affective science describes emotion as an unfolding process shaped by appraisal, regulation, and social interpretation, which remains underexplored computationally. We propose TRACE, a cognition-oriented framework that formalizes an affective episode through three interrelated stages: Condition, Affect, and Effect, integrating observable cues with cognitive factors such as internal stance and regulation of emotional display. Based on this formulation, TRACE-Bench evaluates multimodal models in real-world social scenes through five tasks spanning grounded affect recognition, regulation decoding, cause reasoning, effect reasoning, and full-chain reconstruction, with 3,746 structured question-answer pairs over 646 videos. translated_title: 面向认知的真实世界社交场景中从原因到后果的情绪追踪
translated_abstract: 情感计算已经从类别化的情绪识别发展到基于大型多模态模型的开放式情感分析。然而，情感科学将情绪描述为一个由评价、调节和社会解读所塑造的动态展开过程，这一过程在计算上仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了TRACE，这是一个面向认知的框架，通过三个相互关联的阶段——条件、情感和效应——来形式化情感事件，将可观察的线索与内部立场、情绪表现调节等认知因素相结合。基于这一表述，TRACE-Bench在真实世界社交场景中通过五项任务评估多模态模型，涵盖基于情境的情感识别、调节解码、原因推理、效应推理和全链路重构，包含基于646个视频的3,746个结构化问答对。匹配的人机对比实验揭示了显著的性能差距，而情感……
tldr: 该论文提出面向认知的TRACE框架，通过条件-情感-效应三阶段建模，并构建包含3,746个问答对和646个视频的TRACE-Bench基准，用于评估多模态模型在真实社交场景中从原因到后果的全链路情绪理解能力，发现人机之间存在显著的性能差距。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes TRACE, a cognition-oriented framework formalizing affective episodes through Condition, Affect, and Effect stages, and introduces TRACE-Bench with 3,746 structured QA pairs over 646 videos to evaluate multimodal models on tracing emotions from causes to consequences in real-world social scenes, revealing a substantial human-model performance gap.
